correctness.rationale: For m,n≥2, 2-token vertices partition into X_A=2-subsets of A, Y=mixed pairs, X_B=2-subsets of B. The token graph is connected and bipartite. For its signless Laplacian Q, the equitable quotient B has rows (2n,2n,0), (m−1,m+n−2,n−1), (0,2m,2m). Direct multiplication gives B(n(n−1),(m−1)(n−1),m(m−1))^T=2(m+n−1) times the vector. Every entry is positive; lifting across cells and using irreducible Perron–Frobenius yields rho(Q)=2(m+n−1). Bipartite signature similarity gives rho(L)=rho(Q). Source boundaries m=n=2 are covered; m=1 excluded. Independent reconstruction of 25 whole token matrices 2≤m,n≤6 matched full spectra and quotient, but unbounded correctness rests on the positive-eigenvector argument.
